goal:
T53 — cumulative Critic suite in evolution runs (v3.8 §3.2: regressions must show and be repaired). Today, in
critic mode, the EvoForge lane of an evolution run (services/api/evoforge/evolution_rounds.py, T51) asks the Critic for
tests of the CURRENT round only, so a candidate that adds the new feature but breaks an earlier one passes the Critic
and only the held-out judge sees the regression.

Change: the EvoForge lane keeps every Critic test it received in earlier rounds of the same run (per lane, in memory
for the run) and, each round, runs the accumulated Critic suite (earlier rounds' + this round's) on every applied
attempt. Retry feedback lists failing Critic tests from any round (sealed_eval._critic_feedback). The held-out suite
still only judges and never enters feedback. Record "critic_tests": size of the accumulated suite used this round on the
EvoForge snapshot (single lane: 0 or absent). Emit a role "critic" event "Critic suite: N tests (k new)". Nothing else
changes (scoring, statuses, manifest, previews, single lane).
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t53.py.
